priority: This standalone trajectory protocol overrides local historical SR-first / PROJ-first scripts.
primary_question: Does source-pool asymmetric structure improve trajectory forecasting over general direct trajectory and general net-dynamics models at matched information and path objective?
secondary_real_ablations: SR (two source-selected sign initializations, conditional matched configuration)
main_loss: company -> group -> origin -> horizon equal-weight raw-state path MSE; a fit-only common positive scale may normalize optimizer loss
input_allowlist: past 24 hourly stocks, strictly before t
rate_input_rule: context excludes Y_t; rates receive history/context and known calendar; raw Y enters only source factors; no rolling re-encoding within forecast
direct_rule: one residual MLP call outputs all 24 states, includes learned linear skip and persistence skip; not a collection of single-step models
split_rule: 2018 forward folds; all L+H+1 states valid inside partition; fit target cap 48h before nominal validation start
target_year: reused 2019 retrospective development evaluation; not fresh holdout
budget: Use already available resources only; ceiling 24 aggregate GPU-hours or a smaller existing allocation, whichever is lower. Profile and symmetrically reduce before formal trials.

synthetic_core.note: separate known-driver controlled task; all its arms have identical no-history information; never a field-benefit substitute

claim_guard: TR only beating SR is not enough
No physical hazard claim from net-only rates
No universal two-head or SR-vs-DT theorem

local_data.data_root_default: executor current working directory, recursively searched
local_data.y_only_ledger_allowed: 48 canonical stock arrays, all per-array fingerprints must match; gross audit marked NOT_AVAILABLE
local_data.unsupported_schema_policy: only deterministic adapter preserving frozen cohort, denominator, hour boundaries; no model/data-split redesign; fail closed if identity cannot be established
